question: Which of the following rivers form Kunchikal waterfall in Karnataka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**varahi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Varahi**____** river from Kunchikal waterfall in Karnataka**__.

 __
 
• **Kunchikal Falls** is located in Nidagodu village near Masthikatte in Shimoga district of state Karnataka.
 
• Kunchikal falls cascade down rocky boulders and the total height of fall is 183 meters (600 feet) according to the world waterfall database.
 
• **Kunchikal falls is formed by the Varahi River**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• Hundru Falls is a waterfall in Jharkhand. It is located in the Ranchi district.

 
 
• It is India's 34th highest waterfall. It is one of the most well-known tourist destinations in the area.
 
• On the Subarnarekha River's course, where it drops from a height of 98 meters (322 feet), forming one of the state's highest waterfalls.
 
 
 
• **Jog Falls **is a waterfall on the Sharavati River in the Western Ghats near Sagar Taluk in Karnataka's Uttara Kannada District.
 
• The** Chulia Falls** are west of Rawatbhata and east of Pdjar Nla.
 
• **Dudhsagar Falls** is a four-tiered waterfall in the Indian state of Goa, located on the Mandovi River.
